metadata:
  title: "Test Requirements Registry (BDD fixture seed)"
  version: "2.0"
  last_updated: "2026-10-21"
  description: "One scenario with a subjective outcome"

scenarios:
  E2E-001:
    description: The greeter must print the configured greeting followed by the name it is given so that the Operator reads that person's name in the line it prints
    service: greeter
    path: tests/greeter/greet_test.go
    user_stories: []
    merged_steps:
      given:
        - the greeting is configured as "Hello"
      when:
        - the Operator runs "greet Ada"
      then:
        - the command printed a line on standard output matching "^Hello Ada$"
